rationale: itnet-claude-agentic: pretrain_epochs=80, pretrain_lr=0.0001, itnet_k=1, itnet_alpha=0.005, unet_c=16, finetune_epochs=0, finetune_lr=0.0001, train_n=480, val_n=214, grad_clip=1.0, seed=42, rationale=ITER-8 (search-20260619-01, corrected 214-slice/321px-FOV metric) for itnet = ItNet v1 (pretrain-denoiser-then-FIXED-DC k=1, solver_itnet.py). SIX-BOX (NUMBERS, not CT pixels). (1) TRAJECTORY (val=ALL 214 L277, 321px FOV; hr=metric of record): iter-1 ep8/tn200 k3 SSIM 0.4413/hr 0.000; iter-2 ep48 0.5927/0; iter-3 ep160 0.6430/0; iter-4 ep220 0.7022/0; iter-5 ep140/tn300 0.6932/0 (all k=3, all hr 0). iter-6 itnet_k 3->1 BROKE THE FLOOR: SSIM 0.9332/hr 0.3752 (1281.4s, tn200 ep200). iter-7 train_n 200->300 (ep125, BUDGET BACKSTOP) LIFTED hr 0.3752 -> 0.3989 (SSIM 0.9377, elapsed 1008.9s, #4 on the Mayo board). CURRENT train_n=300 = only ~52%% of the 579-slice train pool. The DATA-COVERAGE lever is WORKING and NOT yet exhausted. (2) LIMITER (k=1 fixed, the breakthrough; pretrain_epochs plateaued in diminishing-returns iters 1-4): the trained SmallUNet denoiser (params_M 0.2329) is now data-coverage-bounded. itnet loads a FIXED stratified train subset ONCE via load_val_split(n=train_n)+randperm, NO rotation; tn300 still misses ~48%% of the 579-slice pool. Campaign doc confirms train_n is the live lever lifting every trainer (uswin 200->480 hr +0.0297 champ; itnet_v3 200->400 +0.0165) and the itnet v1 data probe iter-6->7 just confirmed it on THIS solver (+0.0237). (3) ONE KNOB: train_n 300 -> 480 (+60%% data coverage, ~83%% of the 579-slice pool, +anatomy ps-groups at k=1, from BASE_ITER=7). pretrain_epochs 125 -> 80 is the BUDGET BACKSTOP (NOT a 2nd hypothesis-knob) to hold the HARD 20-min wall at GRAD-STEP PARITY: grad steps 480x80=38400 vs iter-7 300x125=37500 (+2.4%%), so the change ISOLATES DATA COVERAGE from extra optimization. KEEP itnet_k=1 (the breakthrough). All else identical to iter-7 (itnet_alpha=0.005, unet_c=16, pretrain_lr=1e-4, val_n=214, grad_clip=1.0, seed=42). (4) HYPOTHESIS: broader data coverage (52%%->83%% of the pool) lifts hr ABOVE 0.3989 toward the leaders (itnet_v2 0.4187, dd_sup 0.4158, uswin 0.4150), predict ~0.405-0.415, tracking the +0.0237 tn200->300 v1 gain and the +0.016-to-+0.030 sibling-trainer train_n gains. FALSIFIER (operative, NUMERIC): if hr <= 0.3989 at train_n=480/k=1, the data-coverage lever SATURATES for v1 (denoiser is FBP-information-bounded, not data-limited) -> document the saturation and the next lever is a different axis (capacity unet_c / alpha). (5) BUDGET (HARD 20-min = 1200s train+score; sbatch 30-min wall is the only hard fence): iter-7 ACTUAL 1008.9s @ tn300/ep125 (37500 grad steps) came in WELL under the conservative 1213s estimate. Decompose: fixed (data load + 214-slice per-sample val + figure + startup) ~185s; pretrain ~824s over 37500 grad steps = 0.0220 s/grad-step. iter-8 38400 grad steps -> 0.0220*38400 = 845s + 185s fixed = ~1030s = 17.2 min, INSIDE the 1200s HARD wall with ~170s margin and BELOW iter-6 (1281s). val stays ALL 214 L277 slices, 321px detector-geometry FOV (default; NO fov= override). grad_clip=1.0 retained (mandatory: the 2304-view Mayo FBP adjoint inside the DC step overflows otherwise). v1 has NO max_train_s backstop. (6) Loop continues -- no control returned. HARD-WIRED (unchanged): staged_canonical data, v3 mayo_ldct_fitted geometry, per-sample-ps (each val slice swaps itnet.projector to its own ps; chunk=1 FORCED), bg_target=truth, KEEP itnet_k=1, val=ALL 214 L277 slices under the 321px detector-geometry FOV (evaluate_calibrated default for AGENT4CT_DATASET=mayo_ldct_2d; NO fov= override).
